task: Comprehensive redesign of drum sample population algorithm - rethink how samples are matched to drum categories (Kick, Snare, HiHat, Perc) for MIDI pattern generation
enhanced_task: Improve DrumAnalyzer classification accuracy by: (1) Using already-calculated attack time in classification decisions, (2) Adding transient-focused spectral centroid instead of single FFT peak, (3) Adding transient energy ratio feature, (4) Refining frequency band thresholds with attack-aware logic. Also add visual category indicators (k/s/p/h) on sample widgets and right-click manual reclassification option.

changes: Added transientCentroid and transientRatio to AnalysisResult
Added new methods: calculateTransientCentroid, calculateTransientRatio, classifyBandWithFeatures
Updated classifySubType signature to include all features
Implemented transient spectral centroid calculation (analyzes first 30ms)
Updated classifySubType to use attack time and transient features
Added confidence calculation based on multiple features
Added onClassifyOverride_ callback to Tile class
Added manualCategoryOverrides_ map for session-only manual classifications
Added K/S/H/P category letter indicators in Tile::paint()
Added 'Classify as...' submenu to right-click menu
Wired up manual classification callback when creating tiles
Updated onRequestSampleForCategory to check manual overrides first
